verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The Government of India has not launched any "Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Scheme". Messages promoting such a scheme are scams designed to steal personal information.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple official sources, including the Indian government's PIB Fact Check unit and various fact-checking organizations, have repeatedly confirmed that the "Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Scheme" does not exist. The evidence consistently identifies these claims, which have circulated for years, as scams or phishing attempts designed to collect personal and financial information from individuals.

verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: Since the "Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Scheme 2026" does not exist, there is no application deadline for it. The Government of India has not announced any such scheme.
verdicts.reasoning_en: The evidence, including a TIER_1 government source (newsonair.gov.in) and multiple TIER_2 news outlets, confirms that the "Pradhan Mantri Free Laptop Scheme 2026" is not a real government initiative. As the scheme itself is non-existent, any associated application deadline, such as October 15, is also false.

verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The website www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in is not an official government website. It is a fraudulent site associated with a scam, and people should not register on it. Official Indian government websites typically end in ".gov.in".
verdicts.reasoning_en: Evidence from a TIER_1 government source (newsonair.gov.in) and multiple news outlets confirms that the specified website is fraudulent. The PIB Fact Check unit has identified such websites as fake and designed to mislead people and collect their personal information. One source also correctly notes that official Indian government websites typically use the ".gov.in" domain, which this website does not.
